name: mirage
text: That blurb is a generic description of an OpenAPI spec file: a machine-readable list of every call an API offers. It's meant for tools like Postman or code generators, or for an AI agent that builds calls from a schema. It isn't specifically for Claude, and you don't need to do anything with it. If it came from one of your APIs' docs pages, tell me which one. I can read that spec and check Vigilant's code against it. I already did this for the APIs whose specs are saved in the repo (SportsGameOdds, OddsPapi, SharpAPI).
